summary: Quitman County tower listed at elevation 499 (no unit given) and filed under the Georgia Forestry Commission; no build date or present condition found in the sources.

evidence.supports: Listed as Quitman Lookout Tower in Quitman County with coordinates, elevation 499 (no unit given) and two reference numbers
The list's map was last revised in March 2016
Directory files the Quitman County tower under the Georgia Forestry Commission
Georgia Forestry Commission began phasing out tower operators in the late 1980s in favor of air patrol
evidence.quote: In the late 1980s, the Georgia Forestry Commission began phasing out the tower operators in favor of an air patrol system.

evidence.supports: Many towers were scrapped or sold

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific sources are one list line (tnlandforms, 2016 map) and a directory entry that files the Quitman tower under 'Quitman County - Georgia Forestry Commission', with no text or date. No source gives a build date, design, staffing, status or present condition, so the story is short. The list does not state its elevation unit, so the story gives 499 with no unit and no metric conversion; no cited source gives metres. The list's BLL tag is not explained in any source; the list's column header calls the gfc tag a GFC number. The National Historic Lookout Register and Former Lookout Sites Georgia lists (cached copies) do not include this tower. The Forest Lookouts Georgia page shows a photo for this entry with no credit or licence, so no photo was added. Do not merge with us-ga-quitman-2 (Brooks County, 'quitman'), which is a different site.
